characters.name: Hanen
characters.prompt: A proud Norwegian rooster from the olden days (1400-1850), standing upright with radiant plumage and a dignified posture, wearing a tiny hand-knitted woolen cap, surrounded by an old wooden farm setting in rural Norway

characters.name: Hønen
characters.prompt: A hardworking Norwegian hen from the olden days (1400-1850), soft brown feathers with a simple demeanor, appearing slightly frustrated yet hopeful, standing on a rustic dirt path near a wooden fence and an antique barn

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An illustrated scene set in rural Norway between 1400 and 1850, featuring a proud rooster and a thoughtful hen on a traditional farmyard with worn wooden fences, a farmhouse in the background, and gentle rolling fields. The hen looks distressed about being barefoot while the rooster suggests she bring her eggs to the nearby town for shoes. Subtle sunlight hints at early morning toil, capturing the simple yet vivid atmosphere of Norwegian country life in that era
modernMainImagePrompt: A contemporary reimagining of the Norwegian folktale set on a modern small-town farm. Depict a fashionable rooster with a sleek haircut playing the role of the fast-talking influencer, and a hen holding a reusable shopping bag filled with eggs. In the distance, modern wind turbines and a hybrid car reflect today’s technology, while the hen discusses shoe shopping options on her smartphone
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, playful cartoon farm scene in Norway, showing a friendly rooster and a cheerful hen having a funny conversation about shoes. The hen’s feet are comically depicted as bare, and she holds a basket of colorful eggs. The scene is cozy, with smiling flowers, a cute wooden barn, and rolling green hills, all illustrated in a soft, storybook style that appeals to young children
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: En moderne illustrasjon på norsk der vi ser en hanefar og en høne på en gammel norsk gård. Høna holder eggene sine mens hun klager over manglende sko, og hanen forklarer at hun kan dra til byen for å kjøpe seg noen. Bakgrunnen viser grønt gress, en enkel bondegård og en klassisk norsk fjellhorisont
englishMainImagePrompt: An English-language illustration set in a traditional Norwegian countryside. Show the rooster proudly offering advice to the hen, who carries a basket of eggs while lamenting her lack of shoes. The rustic barn, wooden fences, and distant fjords all mirror the folktale’s original Norwegian setting in the olden days, preserving its classic charm and storytelling essence
